briefing: Good evening, Agents. Eurocorp thanks you for your continued ownership.
Director Hale Voss of Kaiju Dynamics has been negotiating to sell Sector 7's neural-chip contracts to a competitor. This is regrettable, and it will be corrected.

Voss is holding a public appearance in Sakura Plaza, under the protection of three bodyguards and a rival syndicate detail. Local police are on retainer to nobody. Keep your weapons holstered near patrols unless you want the whole precinct on you.

Terminate Voss before he reaches his limousine on the eastern boulevard, then reach the extraction VTOL in the north-west. His bodyguards are well trained and would make fine Eurocorp assets. Persuade them if you can.
Civilian casualties will be deducted from your maintenance budget.
